rationale: Lorenzo brings production experience in ML data annotation and LLM training at Abaka AI, while Atharva is building hands-on ML engineering skills with a solid foundation in Python, TypeScript, and tools like MLX. They share focus on LLM tooling and ML research, making this a good mentor-mentee pairing where Lorenzo can offer perspective on real-world data pipeline challenges and Atharva can explore how academic ML work applies to industry-scale AI training.
intro_message: Lorenzo, meet Atharva — an SF State student working on ML engineering who's interested in LLM tooling; could be valuable to compare notes on what real data annotation and training workflows look like.
